newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,000T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,000T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy a total of 23,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday, traders said on Thursday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang has invited tenders for 9,500 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges, including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour has invited the remaining 13,500 tonnes at flat prices.
Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
